# VS Code Extensions Configuration

This directory contains all VS Code workspace configuration files for the CyberMythic Foundry VTT system.

## Files

- xtensions.json - Defines recommended and unwanted extensions for this workspace
- workspace-settings.json - Workspace-specific settings optimized for Foundry VTT development
- coordinator.json - Master configuration file with documentation and guidance

## For New Developers

1. Open this workspace in VS Code
2. VS Code will prompt you to install recommended extensions
3. Install the essential extensions listed in coordinator.json
4. Your workspace settings will be automatically configured

## Customization

- Modify xtensions.json to add/remove extension recommendations
- Update workspace-settings.json for workspace-specific preferences
- Edit coordinator.json to update documentation and workflows

## Troubleshooting

See coordinator.json for common issues and solutions.
